info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Investment Management By Param1-spec
info.description: The Investment Management Update API allows users to modify existing investment management records based on specific parameters. This API is primarily designed for financial institutions and investment managers who need to update investment strategies or portfolio details in real-time. Using the PATCH method, users can selectively update the attributes of an investment management record without affecting the entirety of the data. This helps streamline operations and ensures that investment records remain current and accurate.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific e-trading workbench resource identified by RES-100045. You can modify various attributes associated with this resource to reflect the latest information.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update an existing resource in the e-trading workbench. It should contain only the fields that need to be modified, and the new values should comply with the specified schema. Make sure to include only the relevant data to minimize unnecessary processing.
